representation: original item rows and all 86 item features; timestamp is qid only; symbol and target fields excluded
preprocessing: none; tree models consume raw numeric features, so no learned preprocessing statistics
relevance: per timestamp, sorted unique primary targets map to integer 0..m-1; higher target higher relevance; equal target equal relevance; all-tied group all zero; missing outcomes excluded by frozen dataset; variable universe retained
qid: chronological timestamp factor codes after stable sort by timestamp then symbol; group rows contiguous
splits: existing grouped chronological Train/Validation/reused Test; three fixed expanding walk-forward folds inherited from M16.1
purge: training and validation target_timestamp_8h strictly before next interval start
test_provenance: reused research holdout, not untouched or independent
eligibility: outcome-conditioned complete 8h paths retained for comparability
selection: within each objective: Validation Top-1 primary target, tie-break Validation NDCG@3, then depth3
fit_budget: main 4 + three folds x 4 = 16 maximum market-data fits; no final refit, no early stopping, no seed search
top_k: true normalized-target winner appears among first k item scores; score ties resolved deterministically by symbol ascending
baselines: constant Train winner with Train-frequency fallback

decision.PROMISING_RANK_SIGNAL: ranker-regressor Top-1 >=2pp, uncertainty supports positive effect, >=2 positive walk-forward effects, beats baselines without concentrated explanation
decision.WEAK: positive but below practical threshold or uncertain/temporally unstable superiority
decision.NO_SIGNAL: no sustained advantage over matched regressor

scope_note: ranking formulation vs continuous regression with common item features/backbone; ordinal relevance transformation is part of formulation, not merely a one-line loss change
